title: Plugin: restricted-data readiness (identity, permissions, backup)
description: mlflow-span-review blocks restricted sources until deployed identity/permissions and independent backup/restore are verified (tracked in aida-notes-62m.1.6). Required before CORAL or institutional notes are loaded. Hosting must also pass Amber's destination policy and the dataset's license/IRB terms.

title: Amber AnnotationAdapter for mlflow-span-review
description: amber.review adapter loaded by module path (duck-typed to the plugin Protocol; Amber never imports the plugin). build_result/validate_result build and check a CaseResult-shaped payload using exact_quote, commit_claim, no_claim, and load_case_result-equivalent revalidation. binding() hashes Amber version and adapter policy. Optional extra; core import stays lightweight.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic tests: Unicode/CRLF spans, repeated quotes, missing field evidence, invalid outcomes, forged offsets rejected; fresh-process core import test unchanged.

title: First delivery decision report
description: Decide whether the CORAL rehearsal meets its targets, needs a specific change, or needs more data, and what carries over to the institutional task. Completion is not clinical readiness. Gates conditional work.
acceptance_criteria: Decision documented in docs/notes with evidence; conditional epic children re-prioritized.

title: Freeze configuration and run the held-out evaluation
description: Freeze prompt/model/adapter/thresholds, run on the test partition once, run the effort study, score all protocol gates. Record test-set exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Gate table with counts, intervals, and statuses; exposure logged.

title: Plugin: claim/outcome editor mode for mlflow-span-review
description: External work in mlflow-span-review: AnswerModel-schema form, per-field evidence citation from selected spans, rationale, outcome selector (answered + three no_claim reasons; never failed), compact per-claim evidence view (claim -> inference -> inclusions). Results validated by the Amber adapter. Keep mention mode for AIDA.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin tests plus synthetic browser check of both modes; Amber adapter accepts valid and rejects invalid submissions.

title: Development baseline run, error review, and report
description: Run the fixed pipeline on train/dev only; error review; versioned evaluation report with dataset/manifest/split/adapter/prompt/model versions, costs, latency, and uncertainty. Never touch test.
acceptance_criteria: Report and source-linked Parquet output stored locally; source-free summary documented.

title: Implement the protocol evaluator
description: Metrics, denominators, gate statuses (met/unmet/inconclusive, NA handling), patient/document bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20260915) and Wilson intervals exactly as the protocol specifies; scores final claims only; outcomes by reason. Replace the evaluate.py placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic tests reproduce the protocol's arithmetic examples and edge cases (P=0, Q=0, no automatic answers).

title: Fixed extraction pipeline: run(case) -> CaseResult
description: Service in services/: one call proposes value and candidate quotes; ground via quote, commit via commit_claim or no_claim; bounded retries; failures become failed outcomes; persist to the store. No agent loop.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic end-to-end tests with a fake provider for every outcome kind; results persist and reload.

title: Implement provider protocol and one capability-checked adapter
description: Provider protocol with capability flags; one adapter (e.g. OpenAI-compatible) in backends/ behind an extra; policy check before every call; provenance stamped; failures map to CaseOutcome failure kinds.
acceptance_criteria: Offline tests with a fake transport: policy refusal, capability mismatch, parse failure, retries bounded.

title: Select the permitted provider endpoint for CORAL
description: Choose one endpoint whose zone permits deidentified data AND whose use is allowed by the PhysioNet credentialed license/DUA and its guidance on online services. Confirm structured-output capability, cost per note (gate <= $0.50), and hardware/availability. Model access does not authorize telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded with zone, terms checked, capabilities, and expected cost.

title: Adjudicate disagreements and create gold Examples
description: Third reviewer resolves answer, outcome, or material evidence-boundary disagreements. Convert results to validated Examples with split membership; preserve all reviewer decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Every eligible note has an adjudicated Example; agreement statistics reported.

title: Independent dual review of the 40 frozen notes
description: Each reviewer independently assigns answer or outcome and selects exact evidence per protocol, without seeing the other's work or candidates presented as answers. Record time.
acceptance_criteria: 80 independent reviews stored in permitted local storage with provenance.

title: Recruit and schedule qualified reviewers
description: Two qualified reviewers plus an oncology adjudicator, credentialed for CORAL under the PhysioNet license/DUA and training. Budget their time; it counts toward expert effort.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewers confirmed with credentials; schedule and time-tracking agreed.

title: Choose gold-capture method
description: Protocol requires two independent reviewers with exact evidence plus third-reviewer adjudication. Options (docs/06-annotation-app.md Open decisions): build the annotation tool's author/adjudicate modes early, or a structured form with script-grounded quotes and human resolution of grounding failures. Also decide how gold reviewers/cases stay separate from the M3 timing study.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in docs/06; dependent tasks updated.
close_reason: Decided 2026-10-28: gold capture uses mlflow-span-review blind streams + adjudication with an Amber adapter (docs/06-annotation-app.md). Reviewer separation from the timing study stays in amber-1ah.4.

title: Verify M1 exit evidence and update the inventory
description: Check every M1 exit item in docs/04-roadmap.md against code and tests; update docs/README.md#current-implementation and docs/architecture-status.md.
acceptance_criteria: Full synthetic suite on 3.11/3.12, lint, format, mypy, core-only check pass; inventory reflects reality.

title: Rewrite CORAL adapter for the current schemas
description: experiments/coral/scripts/coral_adapter.py imports nonexistent classes and leaves IDs empty. Build a named, versioned adapter policy mapping a CORAL note to Source (raw bytes, no newline translation), SectionSkip intervals to excluded spans, sensitivity=deidentified, and Case. No gold derivation. Keep CORAL code in experiments/; move reusable parts to src/amber with synthetic tests.
acceptance_criteria: Invented-BRAT tests for CRLF, discontinuous spans, redaction mismatches, skip boundaries; adapter policy version recorded; no CORAL text in repo.

title: Define store protocols and implement local DuckDB store
description: Services depend on store protocols; DuckDB adapter in store/ behind the storage extra. Tables per docs/02 section 10 including immutable source text, claims, evidence, edges, cases/outcomes, annotation_events. Loading revalidates through graph/case boundaries. Core import stays free of DuckDB.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic round-trip tests (Unicode/CRLF, repeated quotes, all outcome kinds); corrupted rows rejected on load; core-only install smoke check passes.

title: Implement annotation events and Example with load validation
description: Implement AnnotationEvent and Example (docs/02 section 6): gold claims with full support closure, explicit final_claim_ids, CaseOutcome, split, annotators, derived_from_events. Failed outcomes cannot become Examples; abstention never becomes a negative answer. Load requires authoritative Source/Task context like load_case_result.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial tests: failed-run Example, missing/unknown final IDs, rejected final claim, broken support closure, split missing; replay of events reproduces state deterministically.

title: Specify review status transitions and annotation-event contract
description: Before implementing events/Example: amend docs/02 sections 4, 6, 10 for human claim status transitions (proposed->verified/rejected/gold), annotation_events fields needed by M3 and gold capture (reviewer role, study arm, review round, session/timing event types), and how adjudication provenance is recorded. See docs/06-annotation-app.md Data and services.
acceptance_criteria: Contract and schema docs updated in one change with rationale; open questions resolved or filed.
notes: 2026-10-28: also specify the per-Example reference tier (adjudicated | single_review | silver), its provenance, the move-on decision record, and label-only silver evaluation records (protocol 1.1.0).

title: Implement provider and destination policy gate
description: policy.py is a docstring-only placeholder. Implement per docs/02 section 7: Provider, Policy (default phi/limited->local,institution; deidentified adds external_baa; synthetic->all), separate destination/sink policy for telemetry, judges, artifact stores, annotation services; check() raising PolicyViolation; stamping zone/sensitivity into Provenance. Pure domain code: no runtime/model imports. Sensitivity is declared, never inferred.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial tests over the full sensitivity x zone matrix and sink checks; fresh-process core import test still passes; inventory updated.

title: Gold reference for the current-progression pilot
description: Independent dual review plus third-reviewer adjudication of the 40 frozen CORAL notes under docs/protocols/oncology_current_progression-v1.md (Gold creation section). This human workload is the critical path for M2/M3 clinical evaluation and is not produced by any code. Candidates from coral_current_progression.py are review aids, never gold.
acceptance_criteria: Every eligible note has an adjudicated reference outcome with exact evidence, stored as Examples in permitted local storage with split membership and provenance.

title: M1: complete task protocol and evidence kernel
description: Remaining M1 scope per docs/04-roadmap.md: provider/destination policy, annotated-data boundary (events, status transitions, Example), one local DuckDB store with Parquet export, a working CORAL adapter, and a local integration report. Protocol, answer schema, exact grounding, graph validation, commits, and case outcomes are already implemented (docs/README.md#current-implementation).
acceptance_criteria: All M1 exit evidence in docs/04-roadmap.md exists; the implementation inventory is updated.

title: Plugin: standalone release and Amber packaging
description: Extract mlflow-span-review from aida-notes into a versioned package (aida-notes-b0z), then add an optional Amber extra. Reconcile Python (plugin >=3.12 vs Amber 3.11-3.12) and MLflow pins (plugin 3.17.x vs Amber tracking >=3.5).

title: Plugin: review timing capture
description: External work in mlflow-span-review: record open/focus/idle/submit events per review revision so expert minutes come from the record, as the protocol's effort gates require.
acceptance_criteria: Timing events retained with revisions and exported to Amber Examples/evaluation.

title: Plugin: teacher proposals for correct mode
description: External work in mlflow-span-review: link Amber CaseResults as editable proposals without placing them in source records; keep source-only streams for manual authoring and blind gold; suppress proposals for test-split cases until the configuration is frozen.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin tests for proposal linkage, source-only isolation, and test-split suppression.

title: Design the manual-vs-assisted effort study
description: Seeded counterbalanced assignment of cases to arms and reviewers, no author-then-correct of the same case, timing attribution (setup, prompt work, correction, adjudication, failed-case review), matched-quality review. Declare before any held-out run.
acceptance_criteria: Study plan frozen with the manifest; reviewer separation from gold capture documented.

title: Review export/import: Sources to review records, references to Examples
description: Export Amber Sources/Cases as mlflow-span-review source records (record_id=source_id, exact text, case/patient/split/sensitivity/adapter-policy metadata, no labels). Import published reference.json into validated Examples: re-ground every quote against the authoritative Source, accepted->gold, excluded/unresolved->diagnostics, annotators/adjudicator/submission IDs->Example provenance and derived_from_events. Example stays the single annotated-data source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic round trip: export -> plugin publication fixture -> import yields Examples equal to the expected graph; tampered text, offsets, or checksums rejected; failed outcomes never imported as gold.

title: Annotation app front-end stack spike
description: One-day spike (docs/06-annotation-app.md Technology): server-rendered FastAPI + small TS selection module vs minimal React/Vite with generated types. Test precise selection, keyboard use, and UTF-16/code-point conversion on a long synthetic note.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in docs/06.
close_reason: Superseded 2026-10-28: no custom front end; review uses mlflow-span-review (docs/06-annotation-app.md).

title: Expert semantic-support review of baseline outputs
description: Experts judge whether cited evidence supports each final claim on development cases; record as annotation events. Required before any LLM judge.
acceptance_criteria: Every dev final claim assessed; time recorded.

title: Run and trace logging through mlflow_ext with destination checks
description: Log runs (provider, zone, sensitivity, dataset hash, prompt versions, adapter policy) and traces via amber.mlflow_ext only. Source-bearing payloads pass the destination policy; default to local tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Tracking tests with the tracking extra; refusal of disallowed destinations tested.

title: Seed task prompt YAML and versioned prompt loading
description: First YAML seed under prompts/ for oncology_current_progression, registration command, and version-pinned loading via amber.mlflow_ext (OSS API only). Code never uses inline prompt strings.
acceptance_criteria: Tests for idempotent registration and load-by-version; missing tracking extra gives an actionable message.

title: Move semchunk out of core dependencies
description: An uncommitted local edit adds semchunk>=4.1.1 to core dependencies (pyproject.toml, uv.lock). Core deps are limited to Pydantic, pydantic-settings, python-ulid, Click, and nothing imports semchunk. Ask the owner: move to the nlp extra with a designed chunking integration, or drop it.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml/uv.lock reflect the decision; core-only install check passes.

title: Remove docstring-only placeholder modules
description: AGENTS.md forbids docstring-only promises. Placeholders: evaluate.py, backends/__init__.py, backends/openai_compatible.py, mlflow_ext/prompts.py (policy.py is replaced by the policy task), plus empty agents/, app/, train/ dirs and empty extraction/annotation routers. Remove or replace with tested code; keep intended locations in docs/04 Deferred implementation locations.
acceptance_criteria: No docstring-only modules remain; tests, ruff, mypy pass; inventory updated.

title: Decide whether Mention/StructuredEvidence are needed for M1 exit
description: The roadmap says implement the schema contract, but the progression task needs neither Mention nor StructuredEvidence and CaseResult.mentions must be empty. Decide: implement minimal validated models now, or record them as deferred until a task needs them, and reconcile docs/04 and docs/02.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in docs; roadmap/contract reconciled.

title: Local CORAL integration report
description: Run the adapter locally over the frozen 40-note manifest; record dataset version/DOI, manifest hash, split, adapter policy version, mapping decisions, and disagreements. Keep the report in ignored restricted paths; commit only a source-free summary if permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Report exists locally; aggregate, source-free findings summarized in docs; policies frozen before held-out scoring.

title: Parquet bundle export with manifest and support closure
description: Native table-bundle export (docs/02 section 10): includes required support closure, exact source-version manifest, split membership, sensitivity. Export is a source-bearing transfer: honor destination policy.
acceptance_criteria: Export/re-import round-trip test on synthetic data; manifest hashes verified; policy refusal tested.

title: M3: minimal correction workflow and first delivery decision
description: Minimal authoring/correction tool over the M1 store (docs/06-annotation-app.md), manual-vs-assisted effort study, frozen held-out evaluation against the protocol gates, and a first delivery decision.
acceptance_criteria: M3 exit evidence in docs/04-roadmap.md reported; decision recorded (meets targets / needs change / needs data).

title: M2: fixed extraction baseline and clinical evaluation
description: One permitted, capability-checked provider; versioned prompt; fixed pipeline using quote/commit/no_claim; evaluator implementing the protocol metrics; development baseline and error review. See docs/04-roadmap.md M2.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible dev baseline, source-linked Parquet output, error review, versioned evaluation report; no tuning on test.

title: Add the IRB-approved institutional corpus and task protocol
description: Owner is preparing an IRB-approved corpus of ~1.6M notes; CORAL is the rehearsal. When ready: task protocol (variables, note vs patient level, gates agreed with users), approved PHI endpoint/compute, data path, population-level sampled validation, and scale execution. Planned direction from the 2026-10-28 discussion: complement Brim-like tools; a poor-man's teacher (YAML variable definitions, marimo refinement notebook, Amber fixed pipeline, optional LangExtract for entity variables) produces gold/silver labels reviewed in mlflow-span-review, distilled into a cheaper student model run at scale. Requires a silver/gold label-tier contract change; promote M7 when started.

title: M8: verifier and operational hardening
description: Online verifier only if calibrated human comparisons show useful error detection at acceptable cost.

title: M7: annotation ladder experiments
description: Demonstrations, prompt optimization, distillation, fine-tuning on disjoint Example splits.

title: M6: expanded annotation app
description: Items listed in docs/06-annotation-app.md Conditional expansion, each justified by observed M3 review needs.

title: M5: note-scoped reviewer and targeted NLP comparison
description: Reviewer over sections/chunks of one note; escalation thresholds from dev curves.

title: M4: bounded PydanticAI extractor comparison
description: Compare against the fixed pipeline under identical split/model/schema/grounding; declared budgets.

title: Terminology/mention-detection experiment
description: Only for a named task need or baseline error (docs/05-terminology-and-mention-detection.md); resolve its listed identity, mapping, and gold-cost issues first.

title: Select-decide bounded experiment
description: Only if dev errors motivate it: evidence-restricted boolean decision vs full-note baseline with an expert-selected-evidence arm (docs/select-decide-evaluation.md).

title: Conditional expansions (M4-M8, terminology, select-decide)
description: Backlog of roadmap work adopted only on measured benefit. Each child must name the development error or need that justifies it and compare against the fixed baseline under the same protocol. Do not start before its blocker.
